question: How many compressors are fitted onboard, along with their descriptions?
db_schema: Tables: M_Equipment(EquipmentName, Universal_ID_M_Equipment), T_EquipmentShipDetail(Nomenclature, EquipmentShipID, Universal_ID_M_Equipment)
sql: SELECT tesd.Nomenclature, COUNT(tesd.EquipmentShipID) AS NumberOfCompressorsFitted FROM M_Equipment AS me JOIN T_EquipmentShipDetail AS tesd ON tesd.Universal_ID_M_Equipment = me.Universal_ID_M_Equipment WHERE me.EquipmentName LIKE '%compressor%' GROUP BY tesd.Nomenclature;

question: How many DARTs have been raised on each compressor?
db_schema: Tables: T_Dart(DartID, Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail), T_EquipmentShipDetail(Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail, Universal_ID_M_Equipment), M_Equipment(EquipmentName, Universal_ID_M_Equipment)
sql: SELECT me.EquipmentName, COUNT(td.DartID) AS NumberOfDartsRaised FROM T_Dart AS td JOIN T_EquipmentShipDetail AS tesd ON td.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail = tesd.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail JOIN M_Equipment AS me ON tesd.Universal_ID_M_Equipment = me.Universal_ID_M_Equipment GROUP BY me.EquipmentName ORDER BY me.EquipmentName;

question: What is the average MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) for any compressor?
db_schema: Tables: M_Equipment(EquipmentID, EquipmentName), T_EquipmentShipDetail(EquipmentID, EquipmentShipID), T_Dart(EquipmentShipID, TotalRunningHours)
sql: SELECT AVG(FailureIntervals.TimeBetweenFailures) AS AverageMTBF FROM (SELECT td.TotalRunningHours - LAG(td.TotalRunningHours, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY tesd.EquipmentShipID ORDER BY td.TotalRunningHours) AS TimeBetweenFailures FROM M_Equipment AS me INNER JOIN T_EquipmentShipDetail AS tesd ON me.EquipmentID = tesd.EquipmentID INNER JOIN T_Dart AS td ON tesd.EquipmentShipID = td.EquipmentShipID WHERE LOWER(me.EquipmentName) LIKE '%compressor%') AS FailureIntervals;

question: Please provide the Maintops of the main engine.
db_schema: Tables: M_Equipment(MaintopID, MaintopNumber, MaintopMaker, MaintopModel, EquipmentName)
sql: SELECT ME.MaintopID, ME.MaintopNumber, ME.MaintopMaker, ME.MaintopModel FROM M_Equipment AS ME WHERE ME.EquipmentName LIKE '%Main%Engine%';

question: What is the current running hour of the Reduction Gear Box?
db_schema: Tables: M_Equipment(EquipmentName, Universal_ID_M_Equipment), T_EquipmentShipDetail(Universal_ID_M_Equipment, Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail), T_Dart(Present_Running_Hours, Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail, DartDate)
sql: SELECT TOP 1 td.Present_Running_Hours, me.EquipmentName FROM M_Equipment AS me JOIN T_EquipmentShipDetail AS tesd ON me.Universal_ID_M_Equipment = tesd.Universal_ID_M_Equipment JOIN T_Dart AS td ON tesd.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail = td.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail WHERE me.EquipmentName LIKE '%Reduction%Gear%' ORDER BY td.DartDate DESC;

question: Who is the OEM/supplier for the AC plant?
sql: SELECT ME.ManufacturerName FROM M_Equipment AS ME WHERE ME.EquipmentName LIKE 'AC plant';

question: What is the equipment code of the refrigeration plant?
sql: SELECT me.EquipmentCode FROM M_Equipment AS me WHERE me.EquipmentName = 'refrigeration plant';

question: How much fuel was consumed in February 2024?
sql: SELECT SUM(TSH.FuelTotal) FROM T_SRARMthlyHeader AS TSH WHERE TSH.SrarMonth = 2 AND TSH.SrarYear = 2024;

question: How many days has INS ___ sailed in 2024?
db_schema: Tables: M_Ship(ShipName, Universal_ID_M_Ship), T_SRARMthlyHeader(HoursUnderwayMonth, Universal_ID_M_Ship, SrarYear)
sql: SELECT SUM(TS.HoursUnderwayMonth) / 24.0 FROM M_Ship AS MS INNER JOIN T_SRARMthlyHeader AS TS ON MS.Universal_ID_M_Ship = TS.Universal_ID_M_Ship WHERE MS.ShipName = '%INS%' AND TS.SrarYear = 2024;

question: What is the maximum number of days at sea in 2024?
sql: SELECT MAX(TH.HoursUnderwayMonth / 24.0) FROM T_SRARMthlyHeader AS TH WHERE TH.SrarYear = 2024;

question: Kindly provide the history/details of Opdefs raised on the AC plant.
db_schema: Tables: T_OpdefMain(OpdefID, OpdefNo, OpdefDate, Defect, EffectOnOperation, Remarks, DIG, Severity, OpDefStatus, EquipmentID, EquipmentShipID, Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail), T_EquipmentShipDetail(Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail, Universal_ID_M_Equipment), M_Equipment(EquipmentName, Universal_ID_M_Equipment)
sql: SELECT om.OpdefID, om.OpdefNo, om.OpdefDate, om.Defect, om.EffectOnOperation, om.Remarks, om.DIG, om.Severity, om.OpDefStatus, om.EquipmentID, om.EquipmentShipID, om.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail, me.EquipmentName FROM T_OpdefMain AS om INNER JOIN T_EquipmentShipDetail AS esd ON om.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail = esd.Universal_ID_T_EquipmentShipDetail INNER JOIN M_Equipment AS me ON esd.Universal_ID_M_Equipment = me.Universal_ID_M_Equipment WHERE me.EquipmentName LIKE '%AC plant%';

question: What was the last Opdef raised by INS ___?
db_schema: Tables: T_OpdefMain(OpdefNo, OpdefDate, Universal_ID_M_Ship), M_Ship(ShipName, Universal_ID_M_Ship)
sql: SELECT TOP 1 tom.OpdefNo, tom.OpdefDate, ms.ShipName FROM T_OpdefMain AS tom INNER JOIN M_Ship AS ms ON tom.Universal_ID_M_Ship = ms.Universal_ID_M_Ship WHERE ms.ShipName LIKE '%INS%' ORDER BY tom.OpdefDate DESC;

question: What is the name of the equipment with serial number 'A-177792'?
sql: SELECT me.EquipmentName FROM M_Equipment AS me WHERE me.EquipmentCode = 'A-177792';

question: Show me all defects reported for ship DART_NUMBER 12345
sql: SELECT td.Defect FROM T_Dart AS td WHERE td.DartNumber = 12345;
